evidence.quote: Jet engine afterburner trail producing a man-made polar light display.

A military jet streaks across the upper frame... The afterburner ignites, throwing a brilliant blue-white cone of flame. The exhaust trail expands and twists behind the aircraft, ionizing the thin upper atmosphere — the plume shimmers, shifting from orange-white at its core to luminous green and violet at its edges, mimicking an aurora.

criteria.rationale: Subject identity (jet, afterburner trail) is preserved. Appearance evolves plausibly from engine glow to ionized, aurora-like plume. No unexplained renaming, duplication, or attribute drift. The description of the plume mimicking an aurora is a stylistic enhancement, not an identity shift.
